author: reek
body: Clan instance server. Each clan runs their own instance of this server on their hardware. It manages clan state locally - economy, library, tournaments, formats - and communicates with the platform authority for authorization, token purchases, and inter-clan operations.

author: reek
body: The platform (MagicServer) is the authorizing authority. Clans buy clan tokens from the platform using global ManaCoin. The clan instance persists its own state for reporting and analysis.
